RESUME_DATA.name: Mark Mikhalev
RESUME_DATA.about: AI Automation Engineer | Business Process Analyst | Team Lead
summary: I'm passionate about everything that makes us better, faster, and stronger. This, along with a diverse experience and an extensive skill stack, helps me deliver positive impact to any enterprise I join regardless of my role. Most of all, though, I like creating work environments where intelligent data-driven systems enable teams to focus on the work they can enjoy and thrive.

Joining IT as a copywriter in a global team, I was quickly promoted to an editor, owning the entire SEO content production cycle. After this project ended, I taught myself digital marketing and started freelancing for international clients, sharpening my skills. Then, I was offered a role in Instaon, a Belgian startup that developed a tool for generating ad copies on a proprietary LLM. This was my first experience working with AI.

Working with AI then provided me a chance to peek at the change that we are experiencing today, and gave me hope to see the second renaissance with my own eyes. Since then, I have been waiting for the moment AI makes the abundance culture a real promise for people, not sci-fi. This moment has come. Today, I help teams adapt to the new reality and apply agentic AI to drive growth.

If you want to help your team and move some things around with AI, you’re in the right place at the right time — I am open to offers. I'm looking for a team of like-minded people to build long-term relationships with and, through little feats, score big wins. I am autonomous, quick to spot areas for growth, and act on them.

You can find an outline of my tech experience below, or download my CV here. And if it feels like a good match with your wants and needs, and you want to talk or offer me a role in your project — hit one of those contact buttons on the right and drop me a line, or book a Calendly slot for a quick chat. I’ll be happy to hear from you and talk about the exciting things we can do make our lives and the world better.

positions.title: AI Automation & Quality Engineer
description: Built and optimized AI-driven automated workflows and QA processes for the internal services team, boosting delivery speed and reducing workload by 25%.
Developed a data-driven AI-enabled quality assurance framework that provided clear metrics for optimizing performance and future growth.
Created comprehensive documentation and user manuals to help with long-term maintenance of these solutions.

positions.title: Technical Support Engineer
description: Conducted in-depth technical investigations to resolve and escalate complex customer issues.

Helped customers implement standard and custom funnel logic, integrations, and interfaces for web2app conversion optimization, leveraging internal and external API services, webhooks, pixels, and other web development solutions.
Co-developed cross-functional workflows and key performance indicators to track team performance and workload.
Collected, organized, and shared with the product team UX insights and customers’ feedback.
Implemented workflow automations that helped enhance team performance and eliminate lost case instances.
Maintained and improved product documentation.

positions.title: Customer Support Team Lead
description: Led a global international team of 12 tech and educational support agents.
Ensured the hiring processes filled the team with desired talent.

Managed the selection and migration to a new software stack, which allowed for streamlined cross-team data integration and unlocked new opportunities for boosting team efficiency and customer satisfaction.

positions.title: Senior Customer Support Agent
description: Fostered team efficiency and user satisfaction by delivering exceptional technical and educational support and serving as a role model for colleagues, keeping their endorsement at 99%.

Designed, built and maintained robust processes and automations to ensure exceptional support, seamless inter-team collaboration, and team development.

positions.title: Customer Support Agent
description: Resolved 3,000 customer cases, maintaining personal CSAT at 95% and above.

positions.title: Customer Success Manager

positions.title: Digital Marketing Manager

Created and managed dozens of Google Ads and Yandex Ads campaigns, increasing client sales by an average of 25% while reducing marketing spend by up to 20% through conversion optimization strategies.

positions.title: Translator

positions.title: Web Content Editor
description: Led a global team of thirty copywriters and graphic designers to deliver high-quality content that met usability standards, SEO requirements, and drove company revenue.
Owned full content lifecycle: from content planning through final editing and publication of more than 4000 articles.
